name: homesafe-security-tests
description: Firestore/Storage security rules tests and an end-to-end evidence hashing test, run against the Firebase emulators.

scripts.test: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-homesafe --only auth,firestore,storage,functions "npm --prefix security-tests run test:run"
scripts.test:rules: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-homesafe --only firestore,storage "npm --prefix security-tests run test:run -- rules"
